functions.behaviour: Runs one explicit experimental command as an asynchronous job under the Session lock and returns a job id; rejects foreign origins, oversize or non-JSON bodies and a busy job.
functions.notes: The per-action effects are the Action rows; only this route pairs the reply with a workspace snapshot.

functions.name: Route POST /api/experiment/native-command
functions.behaviour: Runs the same command body as the command route and returns the paired work snapshot, local cell and native snapshot, optionally with phase and cycle inspections (inspect_boundary, inspect_cycle, inspect_macro, native_since).
functions.notes: An already durable commit or import is never reported as failed when only the paired display refresh fails (adapter.py:2148).

functions.name: Route POST /api/experiment/native-input
functions.behaviour: Applies native input: an explicit turn from verified native tokens (1 to 10,000) into the draft or live puzzle, or a shift-left or shift-right inspection of an interactive native sticker.
entry_points: mouse native puzzle view: shift-left click on a sticker
mouse native puzzle view: shift-right click on a sticker
functions.notes: Shift-left inspects the piece occupying the sticker position; shift-right inspects the position. The native profile and state hash must be current.

functions.name: Route POST /api/experiment/window-layout
functions.behaviour: Saves the detached window rectangles and visibility (local, global, keyboard, macro, operation, solve, puzzle) as workspace preferences without reserving a job; yields to an active operation.

functions.name: Route POST /api/experiment/session-log
functions.behaviour: Bounded-size route for session log inspect, confirmed apply and export (base64 payload up to the log limit).
functions.notes: Rows for the individual log actions are the Action session-log-* rows.

functions.name: Refusal of other POST routes
functions.behaviour: Every POST path other than the experimental command boundary, the shutdown, stop-job and native handshake routes is refused with 403 so no automatic solver route is reachable.
functions.notes: Only the refusal is defined here; shutdown, stop-job and handshake are passed to the previous handler of the host.

functions.name: Backend timing diagnostic
functions.behaviour: When MAGIC600_BACKEND_PROFILE names an absolute file, records bounded per-request worker timings (up to 256 requests) and writes them at process exit.
